affinity.notes: Astral energy, spectral projections, and a smoke body overwhelm any neutral physical base.

anatomy.notes: Spectral arms, orbiting heads, and smoke torso obscure the core body plan.

archetype.notes: Controller and summoner communicates the lamp-court sovereign duty.

counterplay.notes: Multiple raised hands and orbiting apparitions clearly telegraph area control and summoning.

finish.notes: Highly polished with strong purple-gold cohesion.

framing.notes: Symmetrical composition clearly signals a major encounter.

identity.notes: Astral djinn sovereign identifies the Wish Sultan form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
